subtasks.title: Add undo stack and toast state to KanbanBoard

subtasks.title: Add Undo toast UI

subtasks.title: Add Ctrl+Z keyboard shortcut
subtasks.description: Global keydown listener for Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z that pops and reverses the last undo action.
